plain: Changing suddenly and without a good reason.

webster.text: Freakish; whimsical; apt to change opinions suddenly, or to start from one's purpose; unsteady; changeable; fickle; fanciful; subject to change or irregularity; as a man of a capricious temper.

example.quote: But what is to be the object of this capricious partiality in the national councils?
